answer: VDF timing proofs at the jetty: each identity must sequentially hash 2^30 rounds, unparallelizable, before mining. The mirror replays every proof to catch shortcuts; a zephyr of variance can't fake elapsed work. Attacker renting 1000 GPUs still pays the same wall-clock as one honest node, so farming k identities costs k× sequential time. Sybils die because time itself can't be bought in bulk.
